subject: Vendor portal evidence: linkage and consolidation action items
messages:
From: Eli Turner <eli.turner@datashield.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearscope.com
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick alignment: evidence linkbacks and metadata for Whistic profile

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We started scoping ClearScope's onboarding checklist and a few questions came up on how you want evidence linked back inside Whistic vs stored in your S3 staging bucket. Two quick asks so we can keep the ingestion minimal for your team: 

- Can you confirm whether the portal should reference our public S3 objects (we'll provide presigned URLs) or if Redwood prefers attachments uploaded directly into the Whistic file fields?
- We'd like a short mapping of Whistic artifact types to your internal evidence categories (e.g., "network diagram" -> "infrastructure/diagram") so our automation maps filenames correctly.

I've attached a lightweight index (sig_questionnaire-2025.xlsx) showing the SIG rows we plan to populate. If you prefer a one-off staging export from your side, happy to accept that and map on our end.

Suggest a 30-min call Wednesday to confirm.

Best,
Eli
Security Onboarding Lead
DataShield (vendor)

Attachments: sig_questionnaire-2025.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli.turner@datashield.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick alignment: evidence linkbacks and metadata for Whistic profile

Eli — thanks, this is helpful. A few notes from our side: 

1) Preferred flow: upload canonical proofs to our S3 staging bucket and set Whistic file fields to reference the S3 presigned URL. That keeps a single source-of-truth for rotation/TTL and avoids duplicate uploads into Whistic.

2) Mapping: I attached a short CSV spec we use for ingestion (evidence-index.csv). High-level mapping:
- "network diagram": infrastructure/diagram
- "SOC controls": compliance/soc2
- "SSO config screenshots": iam/screenshots

3) Access: we'll create a short-lived IAM role for ingestion. Mina, can you confirm the role name and TTL?

If Wednesday 10am PT works for you, I can loop Jonas to review the ingestion script and we can finalize the presigned URL pattern.

Thanks,
Sooj

Eli — follow up from our side after the ingestion dry run on Friday. Two items to close: 

1) The ingestion script successfully created Whistic file entries pointing to presigned URLs. ClearScope's team needs to ensure uploaded PDFs are under 10MB and filename normalization uses hyphens rather than spaces (we saw a handful with trailing spaces). We'll include a small filename-normalizer in the script but please keep uploads consistent.

2) Control ID tagging: we will pull control_id from the SIG spreadsheet if you populate column "control_id". We attempted a match based on description and had 88% success — the remaining 12% needs manual review. If you can populate the control_id column for the ambiguous rows (I listed them in the attached evidence-index.csv), that will let us finish mapping and move the Whistic profile to "complete" status.

Next steps: once they upload the clarified CSV rows, Jonas will run the automated reconcile and set the profile to Ingested. Jon, can you confirm you'll run reconcile on Tuesday?

Thanks,
Priyom
Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
